FLOW:source>toolchain verification>canonical build configuration>native/.NET/build>symbol+ABI inspection>artifact fingerprint>reproducibility comparison>PASS|WARN|FAIL. STRUCTURE:code/checkers/BuildAbiReproChecker.ts+code/policy/BuildAbiPolicy.ts+code/registry/ToolchainRegistry.ts+code/registry/AbiBaselineRegistry.ts+code/evidence/build-abi/; policy and registries are immutable governance data only,checker verifies and never repairs. TOOLCHAINS:Python native records Python+pybind11+setuptools/build config;C/C++ records MSVC/clang/gcc family+version+target_arch+runtime_library+language_standard+optimization_level+exception_policy+rtti_policy+calling_convention+symbol_visibility+CMake;CSharp records compiler+.NET runtime+target_framework+PlatformTarget+RID;TypeScript records Node+TypeScript+Vite/build tool;SQL records migration version/order+schema baseline. CPP-LOCK:C++20+x64+public ABI C only+C++ symbols hidden unless explicit successor; /MD versus /MT,architecture,standard,flags,exception/RTTI/calling/visibility differences are distinct ABI build identities. ABI-BASELINE:abi_major+abi_minor+exported_symbols+struct_sizes+struct_alignments+field widths/signedness+calling_convention+architecture+runtime; permit compatible minor additive change; FAIL removed symbol+changed width/layout/calling convention+breaking semantics without major bump. EXPORT-GATE:public allowlist only registered gptbridge_* symbols; std/internal classes/vector/parser/mangled C++ symbols private. PYD:_sovereign_native.pyd is formal artifact and records name+hash+architecture+python_abi+compiler+runtime+build_config_hash+source_revision; existence alone never passes. CSHARP:x64 required when consuming x64 native unless registered multi-arch strategy; verify target framework+RID+interop signature+DllImport calling convention+CharSet/encoding+width. REPRO-V1:semantic reproducibility is mandatory:ABI+exports+behavior+config equivalent; binary hash difference caused by timestamp/debug path/PDB/link metadata is WARN with explained normalized diff; bit reproducibility is recorded aspirational level until promoted by successor. MANIFEST:each artifact stores artifact+source_revision+source_hash+compiler+compiler_version+language_standard+target_arch+runtime+flags+dependency_versions+contract_hash+abi_version+build_timestamp+artifact_hash+configuration. CANONICAL-BUILD-POLICY:BuildAbiPolicy is sole value source consumed by CMakeLists.txt+build_native.py+csproj+package.json; checker rejects duplicate/conflicting version/flag definitions. CONFIGURATION:DEBUG and RELEASE have different identities; production accepts RELEASE artifact only and rejects debug CRT+assert/iterator-debug/different optimization contamination. VERDICT:PASS=approved toolchain+arch+compatible ABI+exact exports+complete manifest+semantic reproducibility;WARN=semantic reproducible but unexplained binary hash variance remains bounded;FAIL=unapproved compiler/version+arch/runtime/standard mismatch+public C++ export+removed ABI symbol without major bump+layout change+incomplete manifest+debug artifact in release.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:build existence as proof+unregistered toolchain+mixed /MD /MT identity+x86/x64 or Debug/Release mixing+public C++ symbols+ABI baseline overwrite+removed/changed ABI without major version+independent version/flag truth in build files+missing manifest+byte-identical V1 requirement that ignores semantic normalization+WARN promoted to PASS without evidence+checker changing build config.
articles.exception: Registered multi-architecture or bit-reproducible profiles require separate artifact identities and evidence; neither may weaken semantic reproducibility or release configuration isolation.

articles.subject: release-compatibility-evidence-aggregation-and-upgrade-gate
articles.rule: GATE:RELEASE_COMPATIBILITY returns exactly PASS|WARN|FAIL and answers:language boundaries intact? API/ABI intact? old consumers work? migrations safely upgrade? native failure falls back? every required gate passed? AGGREGATION:consume immutable evidence only from Language Boundary+Dependency DAG+Contract Parity+Ownership Uniqueness+Native Promotion+Resource and Concurrency+Build ABI Reproducibility Gates; never reimplement their checks; any required FAIL=>release FAIL; WARN blocking is explicit immutable ReleaseCompatibilityPolicy per category and cannot be improvised. STRUCTURE:code/checkers/ReleaseCompatibilityChecker.ts+code/policy/ReleaseCompatibilityPolicy.ts+code/registry/SupportedVersionRegistry.ts+code/evidence/release-compatibility/; policy/registry data only; registry fields release+supported_api_range+supported_abi_range+supported_schema_range+supported_previous_releases. MATRIX:compare current release with every previous supported release for TypeScript/Python API,Python/native parity+fallback,C ABI major/minor+symbols,CSharp/native interop,SQL schema+migration,Python public package entry,native artifact architecture/runtime/toolchain; prove prior API/ABI ranges and schema upgrade path remain supported. CHANGE-CLASS:PATCH permits bug fix/internal optimization/performance/implementation only and denies contract/ABI/schema break;MINOR permits optional field,new operation/capability/ABI symbol only while old consumer works;MAJOR alone permits removal/required rename/operation or ABI symbol removal/layout/incompatible semantics with explicit migration. CONSUMERS:test old TypeScript client>new Python backend and new client>supported old backend when bidirectional window declared; old supported native consumer>new C ABI load+behavior. SQL-UPGRADE:old schema>ordered transactional migration>new schema>new application; verify rollback policy+data preservation+indexes+constraints and activation order before Python requires new field. NATIVE-DUAL:every approved accelerated capability runs identical integration suite native-enabled and native-disabled Python fallback; either failure=>release FAIL. UPGRADE-PATH:at least N-1>N with existing config+DB+native state; verify startup+API+DB+native+CSharp+UI contract. MANIFEST:release_version+source_revision+api_version+abi_version+schema_version+python_version+typescript_version+cpp_toolchain+c_toolchain+dotnet_version+native_artifact_hash+contract_hash+schema_hash+supported_previous_versions+all gate_results+ReleaseCompatibility verdict; content-addressed and immutable. OUTPUT:RELEASE_COMPATIBILITY+verdict; failures include category+change/operation/symbol/capability+old+new+rule+reason+required_action. READONLY:checker only aggregates,compares,judges and reports; no repair.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:new-new pair only+required gate FAIL overridden+WARN policy invented at runtime+PATCH contract/ABI/schema change+MINOR breaking old consumer+major break without migration+SQL migration execution-only test+new field used before migration+native-only integration test+fallback failure accepted+missing N-1 upgrade+incomplete manifest+automatic major bump+contract/ABI/migration/fallback mutation+lowered standard+self-repair.
articles.exception: A project declaring no backward compatibility window must still test N-1 migration to a typed unsupported-version outcome that preserves data and supports rollback; silent breakage is never allowed.

articles.subject: language-governance-final-decision-and-evidence-freshness-gate
articles.rule: SOLE-QUESTION:may the current change,integration,build or release be accepted under programming-language governance; FINAL-RESULT:exactly APPROVED|APPROVED_WITH_WARNINGS|REJECTED|INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE; upstream checkers produce evidence verdicts only and never final acceptance. CHAIN:LanguageBoundary>DependencyDAG>ContractParity>OwnershipUniqueness>NativePromotion>ResourceConcurrency>BuildAbiReproducibility>ReleaseCompatibility>LanguageGovernanceFinalGate. STRUCTURE:code/final/LanguageGovernanceFinalGate.ts+code/policy/FinalDecisionPolicy.ts+code/policy/EvidenceRequirementPolicy.ts+code/registry/GateRegistry.ts+code/registry/WaiverRegistry.ts+code/evidence/final-decisions/; policies/registries are immutable data; Final Gate reads evidence+policy+registry+previous baseline+current revision and never rescans code or reimplements a checker. CRITICALITY:CRITICAL=ABI/API/ownership/illegal-language/authority and always blocks;HIGH=fallback/resource/dependency/release-compatibility and blocks unless policy explicitly classifies a narrowly non-failing warning;MEDIUM=performance/maintainability/nonbreaking drift policy-controlled;LOW=naming/noncritical advice nonblocking. DECISION:CRITICAL FAIL=>REJECTED;missing/invalid/stale required evidence=>INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE;HIGH FAIL=>REJECTED;policy-permitted warnings=>APPROVED_WITH_WARNINGS;otherwise APPROVED; missing evidence is never PASS and order prevents a missing proof hiding a known rejection. CHANGE-SCOPE:classify TS-only|Python-only|native|C-ABI|CSharp|SQL|cross-language|release through changed files+contracts+affected dependency graph; rerun only required gates and reuse only content-addressed proof that affected scope is unchanged. REQUIRED-EVIDENCE:{.py application=>language+dependency+ownership+pytest}|{.ts/.tsx=>language+dependency+contract+vitest}|{.c/.h=>language+ABI+contract+native-tests}|{.cpp/.hpp=>language+DAG+ownership+resource+native-tests}|{.cs=>language+interop+ownership+xUnit}|{.sql=>language+migration+compatibility+DB-tests}|{API-contract=>parity+compatibility}|{native-promotion=>profile+benchmark+fallback+resource}|{release=>all-required-gates}; .pyi,.d.ts,.inl follow owning-language plus declaration parity. EVIDENCE-IDENTITY:source_revision+policy_version+contract_hash+toolchain_hash+timestamp+scope+input/artifact hashes+gate version+verdict; evidence revision must equal applicable current revision or prove affected scope unchanged by exact hashes/graph; contract/header/schema/policy/toolchain change invalidates dependent reuse; stale evidence=>INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE. DECISION-RECORD:decision_id+revision+scope+policy_version+result+required_gates+executed_gates+skipped_gates+reused_evidence+critical_findings+warnings+contract_hash+abi_version+schema_version+toolchain_baseline+decision_timestamp+lineage; output LANGUAGE GOVERNANCE FINAL plus revision,scope,result,each gate verdict/N-A,counts and evidence references. READONLY:read+adjudicate+record immutable decision only; no code/version/ABI/policy/registry/waiver change and no implicit WARN ignore. WAIVER:separate registry record waiver_id+rule+scope+reason+approver+expires_at+revision_range+evidence; checker/final-gate cannot create it; illegal seventh authored language+public C++ ABI+duplicate canonical owner+breaking ABI without major+required fallback absent are non-waivable CRITICAL invariants.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:checker final acceptance+Final Gate rescanning code+FAIL-count-only decision+missing evidence as PASS+stale/cross-revision evidence reuse without unchanged proof+runtime warning ignore+automatic repair/version/ABI/policy/registry/waiver mutation+inline path ignore+waiver without approver/expiry/revision scope+waiving non-waivable invariant+APPROVED before complete required matrix.
articles.exception: None for non-waivable CRITICAL invariants or evidence freshness. A valid separate waiver can affect only a policy-declared waivable MEDIUM/LOW or narrowly classified HIGH warning and never converts missing evidence into PASS.

articles.subject: unified-language-source-index-graph-ir-and-incremental-planner
articles.rule: CORE:scan once+parse once+build one Unified Source Index and one Unified Language Graph consumed by LanguageBoundary,DependencyDAG,OwnershipUniqueness,ContractParity,NativePromotion,BuildAbi,ReleaseCompatibility and Final Governance; no checker rescans repository or owns a private graph. SOURCE-INDEX:one SourceUnit per canonical file stores path+language+source_class+module+owner+content_hash+mtime advisory only+imports+includes+exports+symbols+functions+classes+public_entries+contracts+capabilities+native_bindings+test_type+generated+third_party+parser_version+revision; hash,not mtime,is reuse authority. PARSERS:PythonParser+TypeScriptParser+CParser+CppParser+CSharpParser+SqlParser each use its authoritative parser/resolver but emit one normalized ParsedSource{language,imports,exports,declarations,symbols,contracts,dependencies}; checkers cannot depend on language AST internals. GOVERNANCE-IR:thin derived model only,not language/bytecode/authority; canonical types SourceUnit+CallableSymbol+Symbol+Dependency+Capability+Contract+NativeBoundary+TestEvidence+BuildArtifact. GRAPH:NODES=file|module|capability|contract|symbol|artifact;EDGES=IMPORTS|INCLUDES|CALLS|IMPLEMENTS|BINDS|ADAPTS|OWNS|FALLBACK_OF|GENERATES|TESTS; one stable node/edge identity+provenance; example PythonAPI BINDS pybind11 CALLS C-ABI IMPLEMENTS C++vector and PythonFallback FALLBACK_OF capability. INCREMENTAL:file content hash unchanged reuses IR only when parser_version+policy_version+contract_hash also match; changed file reparses once,updates graph transactionally and invalidates reverse-dependency affected subgraph; policy/parser/contract change invalidates all dependent cache even with unchanged source. AFFECTED-SCOPE:ChangedFiles>AffectedScopeResolver>affected modules+contracts+capabilities+artifacts; gptbridge_native.h change necessarily affects C ABI+pybind11+CSharp interop+native artifact+contract parity+build ABI+release compatibility. EVIDENCE:every gate outputs GateEvidence{gate_id,rule_ids,revision,scope,result,severity,findings,source_hashes,policy_version,parser_version,contract_hash,generated_at,input_graph_hash}; one schema only,never gate-specific incompatible result formats. PLANNER:change scope+EvidenceRequirementPolicy>GovernanceExecutionPlanner>only required gates; .tsx runs language+dependency+contract when affected+Vitest+Final; vector.cpp runs language+dependency+ownership+native+resource+build/ABI+native tests+Final; release runs full verification. AUTHORITY:Codex canonical; SourceIndex+graph+AST/IR cache+evidence derived,rebuildable,non-authoritative and prohibited from inventing policy. STAGES:save fast incremental;pre-commit affected scope;integration affected graph;release full verified graph. STRUCTURE-ROLES:governance/language/index/SourceIndex.ts;parser six adapters;ir/GovernanceIR.ts;graph/LanguageGraph.ts;planner/AffectedScopeResolver.ts+GovernanceExecutionPlanner.ts;evidence/GateEvidence.ts;checkers existing gates; equivalent physical layout allowed only when registry maps these exact single responsibilities without merging authority. CONSISTENCY:index/graph generation is atomic+generation-fenced+content-addressed; incomplete parse/graph=>INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE and prior cache cannot masquerade current.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:multiple repository scans per governance cycle+checker-private AST/graph/index+language AST leaking into checker contract+mtime-only reuse+cache as authority+policy change with stale cache+partial graph publish+unresolved parser treated absent+gate-specific evidence schema+fixed run-all planner at save/pre-commit+skipping required affected gate+incremental evidence used for release full verification+checker inventing policy from graph.
articles.exception: Release may reuse a source parse only when source_hash+parser_version+policy_version+contract_hash and resolver/build configuration hashes exactly match; release still verifies the full graph and all required gates.

articles.subject: governance-full-scan-baseline-incremental-golden-parity-and-cache-correctness
articles.rule: BASELINE:before optimization establish a reproducible FULL scan baseline recording revision,source_file_count,source_bytes,scan_time,parse_time,graph_build_time,gate_time,total_time,peak_memory,cache_size,finding_count,warning_count,failure_count; it is the canonical comparison evidence for incremental work,not an authority over Codex. SCENARIOS:benchmark single .py,.tsx,gptbridge_native.h,vector.cpp,.sql migration,shared contract and policy changes; require incremental work to be less than full work without fixed speed multiplier. GOLDEN:after every incremental run execute or compare against an applicable FULL scan and require exact normalized finding parity by rule,severity,source,target,capability,contract,symbol,result; any omitted or extra governance finding is FAIL regardless of speed. INVALIDATION:maintain reverse dependency closure; a changed dependency invalidates all governed downstream consumers to policy-defined depth. Header changes invalidate dependent translation units,C ABI,binding,CSharp interop,Python native adapter,native artifact and consumer/release compatibility evidence. contract_hash changes invalidate TypeScript+Python contract evidence,ContractParity,consumer and release compatibility. policy_version,parser_version,governance_ir_version,graph_schema_version or checker_version changes invalidate every dependent IR/graph/evidence even when source is unchanged. CACHE-KEY:source_hash+parser_version+governance_ir_version+graph_schema_version+policy_version+checker_version+contract_hash plus applicable resolver/build hashes. CACHE-SAFETY:truncated,wrong-schema,bad-hash,unknown-version or otherwise poisoned cache is discarded and deterministically rebuilt; invalid cache may only reduce speed and can never skip a checker,reduce scope,or produce approval. Cache stores parsed IR,graph fragments,hashes and intermediate evidence only; no permanent approval,waiver or authoritative decision. MODES:FAST=save-time changed file+direct affected scope;PRECOMMIT=changed files+transitive dependencies+required gates;FULL=entire repository+all gates with no reliance on incremental verdict alone. TRIGGERS:save FAST;pre-commit PRECOMMIT;main integration FULL;release FULL+release gates;policy/parser/IR/graph migration FULL. PERFORMANCE-EVIDENCE:revision,mode,changed_files,affected_files,cache_hits,cache_misses,parse_count,reused_count,duration_ms,peak_memory,full_findings_hash,incremental_findings_hash,parity; parity=true is mandatory. ACCEPTANCE:correctness first;incremental findings equal FULL findings;incremental work less than FULL work;unchanged files mostly reused;no fixed 10x requirement. A stale evidence reuse or parity mismatch is CRITICAL and blocks Final Governance.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:optimizing without FULL baseline+accepting faster incomplete findings+mtime-only validity+non-transitive invalidation+header/contract/policy/parser/checker/schema drift with reused evidence+cache corruption causing skipped checks+cache-held permanent approval+incremental replacing integration/release FULL verification+hardcoded universal speed multiplier+stale evidence classified below CRITICAL.
articles.exception: A FULL run may reuse verified parse artifacts only when every cache-key component and input provenance matches exactly; it must still cover the entire repository,execute all required gates,and reproduce the canonical normalized findings.

articles.subject: language-governance-schema-v1-stability-freeze-and-regression-corpus
articles.rule: PURPOSE:freeze the program-language governance architecture,not GPTBridge feature development. VERSION:Language Governance Schema v1.0.0 governs allowed six languages,canonical roles/extensions,dependency DAG,C ABI,native path,Python fallback,test ownership,Governance IR,GateEvidence and Final Decision model; change to any core structure is a governance-schema change. FROZEN-ROLES:Python=control+semantic+business;TypeScript=presentation+client+build-time;C=stable native ABI;C++=private native performance;CSharp=Windows/.NET adapter;SQL=relational data operations. FROZEN-PATHS:Python>binding/C-ABI>C++;Python>SQL;TypeScript>canonical information layer>Python;Python/C-ABI>CSharp>Windows/.NET. These roles/edges cannot change without Codex-authorized schema version evolution. PUBLIC-API:stable public governance interface is scan()+analyze()+validate()+getEvidence()+getDecision(); parser/cache/graph/AST adapters/incremental resolver/checker implementations are internal and replaceable only with behavior parity. IR-V1:fixed core models SourceUnit,Symbol,CallableSymbol,Dependency,Capability,Contract,NativeBoundary,BuildArtifact,TestEvidence,GateEvidence; optional additive compatible fields require MINOR,removal/rename/type or semantic change requires MAJOR; compatible correction requires PATCH. REGRESSION-CORPUS:retain authored six-language valid fixtures and invalid fixtures for ts-direct-python,public-cpp-abi,duplicate-owner,missing-fallback,abi-break,dependency-cycle,forbidden-extension plus every corrected regression. GOLDEN-DECISIONS:each critical fixture binds immutable input hashes,expected evidence,rule ids,severity and final decision; parser/graph/cache/checker refactor must reproduce them,otherwise human review plus authorized schema change is required. CONVERGENCE:stable path is exclusively SourceIndex>GovernanceIR>LanguageGraph>Checkers; checker filesystem walks,private language classification and private dependency maps are duplicate infrastructure and must transition ACTIVE>DEPRECATED>REMOVED. DEPRECATION:deprecated public APIs remain compatible with explicit warning through at least one MINOR line and may be removed only in MAJOR; registry records state,introduced version,replacement,deprecation version,removal version and consumers. POLICY-INTEGRITY:checker reads Codex-derived policy+IR and emits evidence; checker source cannot invent hidden language rules,waivers or enforcement. BOUNDARY:stable/ is release-blocking only after Codex authorization,complete regression and promotion evidence; experimental/ may observe and emit non-blocking evidence but cannot alter stable evidence,decision or release. FREEZE-GATE:v1 becomes FROZEN/STABLE only after six-language mapping,DAG,IR v1,Evidence v1,Final Decision schema,full/incremental parity,regression corpus,golden decisions,API/ABI compatibility,release pipeline all PASS;zero duplicate filesystem scanners,stale-evidence defects and unresolved CRITICAL findings. Until proven, lifecycle is FREEZE-PENDING and no claim of STABLE is allowed.
articles.prohibition: FORBID:changing frozen language role/edge without schema evolution+public consumers depending on internal parser/cache/graph types+unversioned IR/evidence/final-decision break+checker-authored hidden policy+multiple authoritative scan paths+immediate deprecated API removal+experimental checker blocking release+declaring STABLE with missing evidence+golden decision drift accepted automatically.
articles.exception: Internal implementation and optional additive schema fields may evolve under PATCH/MINOR compatibility evidence without changing frozen semantics; urgent security containment may disable a component but cannot silently redefine the schema.
